title: hieracium nigrescens subsp. hastatulum
intro: Hieracium nigrescens subsp. hastatulum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which can help alleviate conditions such as wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are known to exhibit antioxidant and anti-cancer properties. These bioactive compounds may help protect against oxidative stress and cell damage, supporting overall health and well-being.
